name: Pattern Recognition (Bonus Components)
description: Supplementary evidence for entries. At high confidence, patterns can fire as standalone RISKY signals. Otherwise they provide bonus points toward tier.

rules.body_confirmation_bonus: bodyOk = close > open. Worth +1 bonus only, never a hard gate.
rules.fls_requires_vector: Fractal Liquidity Sweep requires vector agreement — never trade FLS against declining vector
rules.delta_imbalance_not_milk: Delta imbalance zones are NOT Milk zones — different source, different weight
rules.secondary_vec_bonus: Any secondary-interval vector (1m/5m/15m/60m) below price = +1 bonus
rules.standalone_risky: Pattern alone at high confidence (>=25 occurrences, >=72% win rate) fires as RISKY
rules.standalone_riskiest: Pattern alone at low/medium confidence fires as RISKIEST

fractal_liquidity_sweep.condition: 5-bar fractal sweep + close back inside range + vector agrees

delta_imbalance_bullish.condition: buyer-heavy candle in last 20 bars > 1.5x average imbalance
